sentences.text: In the Mainz-Bingen region, the Small White has 576 reports over ten years, with a main season from June to September and the strongest numbers in August.
It has been recorded eating Red Clover (24 GloBI records), Valeriana rubra (23) and common dandelion (18).
Further records show it eating Rapeseed (14 records) and Hawkweed Oxtongue (11 records).
It has also been recorded eating Alfalfa and Purple Loosestrife (8 records each) and Oregano (7 records).
